construction: Equal-weighted, monthly-rebalanced, buy-and-hold between rebalances; dated membership changes take effect same-day. Benchmark = CSI 300 (沪深300).
history_note: Series before a basket's creation date are a backtest of the membership as of creation; live tracking starts at creation. Universe = the free china_search top-market-cap A-share cache (~5y).
note: Curated A-share thematic baskets — hindsight-curated and descriptive, not an out-of-sample backtest and not a buy list.
